name: Magister’s Companion
body:
Your ties to nature have attracted a guardian companion to assist you.

Prerequisite: Magister 5, 9 or more spells known from the druid spell list.

Benefit: You gain an animal companion. You may select from the following list: badger, bird, camel, cat (small), dire rat, dog, horse (heavy or light), pony, snake (viper or constrictor), or wolf. If appropriate for the campaign, you may choose shark instead. This animal is a loyal companion that accompanies you on your adventures.

This feat functions like the druid animal companion ability (which is part of the nature bond class feature), except that your effective druid level is equal to your magister level –4.
